title: Burst Balloons
description: You are given `n` balloons, indexed from 0 to `n - 1`. Each balloon has a painted number `nums[i]`. Bursting balloon `i` gives `nums[i-1] * nums[i] * nums[i+1]` coins. Return the maximum coins you can collect by bursting balloons wisely.
input_format: First line contains integer `n`, followed by `n` integers.
hints: Think in reverse: instead of which balloon to burst first, choose which balloon bursts LAST in range [left, right].
The last balloon k is bordered by nums[left-1] and nums[right+1].
